key.name: toggle-pin
key.description: Keyboard shortcut used to pin or unpin the currently focused window.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Area of the top panel where the Pin Window indicator appears.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Position of the indicator inside the selected panel area. Zero means first.

key.name: pin-opacity
key.description: Default opacity applied to pinned windows. 255 is fully opaque.
